tickerText: [TENNIS] Ben Shelton heads to Davis Cup in Prague days after his US Open final loss, while new world No. 1 Elena Rybakina becomes the first player to qualify for the 2026 WTA Finals in Indian Wells • [SQUASH] Paul Coll and Amina Orfi reach the Qatar Classic quarter-finals in Doha as Nouran Gohar faces defending champion Hania El Hammamy for a 34th career meeting • [BADMINTON] Malaysia's Aidil Sholeh stuns top seed Jason Teh to win the Vietnam Open men's singles as shuttlers turn toward the Asian Games in Japan • [PICKLEBALL] Pro qualifying and Senior Open play headline day two of the Veolia Arizona Open in Mesa with 1,000 ranking points and $1M+ on the line • [TABLE TENNIS] Truls Moregard and Miwa Harimoto take WTT Champions Macao singles titles after Moregard beat Calderano 4-1 and Harimoto rallied past Chen Yi in seven games

newsItems.title: Coll and Orfi Into Qatar QFs
newsItems.excerpt: Defending champion Paul Coll swept into the Qatar Classic quarter-finals with an 11-2, 11-4, 11-3 win over Dimitri Steinmann, while Amina Orfi also advanced as Rachel Arnold upset Nour El Sherbini in Doha.

newsItems.title: Aidil Claims Vietnam Open
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 91 Aidil Sholeh Ali Sadikin beat top seed Jason Teh 21-16, 21-14 in Ho Chi Minh City for his first BWF World Tour men's singles title since 2024.

newsItems.title: Arizona Open Qualifying Begins
newsItems.excerpt: The Veolia Arizona Open moves into Senior Open and pro qualifying in Mesa as the PPA Tour's first 1,000-point open of 2026 heads toward main-draw action later this week.

newsItems.title: Macao Champions Crowned
newsItems.excerpt: Sweden's Truls Moregard defeated Hugo Calderano 4-1 and Japan's Miwa Harimoto outlasted Chen Yi 4-3 to win the men's and women's singles at WTT Champions Macao on Sunday.
